question: Javelin thrower Neeraj Chopra became the ____ Indian to win a medal at World Athletics Championships in July 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is **__second__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Neeraj Chopra

 
 
• Neeraj Chopra on 24 July 2022 won a Silver medal in the men's javelin throw event at World Athletics Championships in Eugene, US.
 
• Chopra grabbed the 2nd position with his best throw of 88.13 metres.
